releases.name: Claude Fable 5.2
releases.notes: Officially checked 2026-11-14. Standard mode USD 8 input / 40 output per million tokens; optional fast mode is USD 16 / 80. Specifications: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/overview. Announcement: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2.

releases.name: Claude Mythos 5.2
releases.notes: Officially checked 2026-11-14. Restricted to verified organizations; not general API availability. Shares Fable 5.2 specifications and USD 8 / 40 standard-mode pricing; fast mode USD 16 / 80. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/overview
releases.pricingConditions: Access restricted to verified organizations; excluded from general price comparisons.

releases.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
releases.notes: Officially checked 2026-11-14. General paid API rollout on 10 November follows restricted Fairwind access on 28 October. Introductory USD 2 input / 10 output per million tokens is conditional and excluded from unqualified price comparisons. Combined input/output context up to 1M; no standalone maximum output asserted. https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-4-carbon/
releases.pricingConditions: Introductory pricing; paid API tiers. See official announcement for current terms.

releases.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
releases.notes: Officially checked 2026-11-14. USD 1.50 input / 7.50 output per million tokens, flat across the 1M context window. Up to 1M output tokens. Provider benchmark claims are not independent rankings; no benchmark score imported.

releases.name: Qwen4-Max-Preview
releases.pricingConditions: Token Plan only; no global USD token rate verified.
releases.notes: Officially checked 2026-11-14. Preview via Token Plan only. 1M context and 393,216 maximum thinking plus output tokens; not a standalone visible-output allowance. No global token price asserted. Specifications: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-generation-model

standings.change: Canonical official Fable 5.2 and Hydrogen prices become eligible for future snapshot inputs. Existing frozen snapshots and all capability scores remain unchanged. Carbon and Mythos conditional prices remain excluded.

announcements.whatChanged: Built-in application tools on existing deepseek-flash endpoint. No new model or numeric change inferred.
